question_text: An archive stores medical diagrams that must be reconstructed bit-for-bit. Describe why lossless compression should be chosen and why it may fail to reduce a file below a fixed size limit.
adaptation_rationale: Retain compression/no-quality-loss reasoning; remove mail-application procedural requirements. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Lossless compression reconstructs all original data. It removes representational redundancy, whose amount depends on the data, so a guaranteed compression ratio is impossible for arbitrary files.

marking_points.criterion: Uses redundancy/repeated patterns for reduced representation.
Compression depends on content; already compressed/random data may shrink little.
